An independent Arabic FORMAT-locale probe caused the reference to create a segment named with Arabic-Indic digits and then reject that same filename on reopen because generation is locale-sensitive while discovery accepts only ASCII digits.

Static inspection found advertised adversarial cases that are absent from the executable suites, including a partial length field, a record-offset gap, and a current-term over-leader acknowledgement; the suites also miss both independently reproduced failures.
